<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Declare a new version of a handling policy"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/exception-policies/{sourceType}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Declares the handling policy of a source type at the next version
(versions are append-only: the first declaration is version 1, every
accepted declaration after that is +1). `sourceType` is the full
CloudEvents type of the governed source fact; the service checks its
shape only (`com.warehouse.wms|wes.<context>.<entity>.<Event>`), not
that a consumer for it exists. The new version governs cases opened after the
declaration; open cases keep the severity, queue and SLA they were
opened with. `autoResolve` is omitted or null when the source type has
no auto-resolve rule. Requires an `Idempotency-Key`. Publishes
`ExceptionPolicyDeclared`.

A replay with the same key and\nthe same request (method, path and body) returns the stored response\nwith the header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a\ndifferent request is a 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128}},{"name":"sourceType","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The full CloudEvents type of the governed source fact, URL-encoded\n(its dots and colons are significant), e.g.\n`com.warehouse.wes.fulfillment-execution.task.TaskCPTMissed`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":5,"maxLength":200,"pattern":"^com\\.warehouse\\.(wms|wes)\\.[a-z][a-z-]*\\.[a-z][a-z-]*\\.[A-Za-z0-9.]+$"},"example":"com.warehouse.wes.fulfillment-execution.task.TaskCPTMissed"}]}
